name: jet-a
prompt: A single stylised jet aircraft icon glyph on a fully transparent background, seen exactly from directly above (pure top-down plan view, no perspective), nose pointing to the upper right at exactly 45 degrees, centred, filling about 80 percent of the frame. Design: a simplified glossy white jet like a smooth injection-moulded plastic toy or a premium app glyph, soft rounded volumes, no detail. Our own proportions: a long slim pencil fuselage with a soft rounded nose; clean, strongly swept wings set slightly aft of the middle, with a gently curved trailing edge and small rounded raked tips; NO engines under the wings; instead two small smooth capsule engines mounted on the rear fuselage either side of the tail; a T-tail whose small swept tailplane sits at the very end of the fuselage. Pure white porcelain-like plastic with a crisp, strong glossy specular highlight running along the fuselage spine and the leading edges of the wings, very soft cool grey shading on the far side. No shadow, no background, no ground.

name: jet-b
prompt: One minimalist glossy white jet glyph, isolated on a fully transparent background, viewed straight down from above (orthographic top view), nose pointing to the top right corner at 45 degrees, centred and filling about 80 percent of the frame. It looks like a smooth rounded toy plane or a soft 3D app icon glyph, not a realistic airliner: slender long fuselage with a rounded nose and tapered tail, elegant strongly swept-back wings with a slight crescent curve and rounded tips, no wing engines, two small rounded engine pods tucked on the rear fuselage beside the tail, a small swept T-tail tailplane at the very tail. Glossy white lacquer with a sharp bright specular highlight along the top of the fuselage and the wing leading edges, gentle soft grey shading. No shadow, no ground, no background.
